contexts.text: They are reduced into plenary ignorance. SE 4051.
He fully conjoined the Human essence with the Divine.
Falsities... confirmed are called... Full of days ().
Separation is not plenary taking away...
A full state of unition (of the Divine of the Lord with His Human). Signified. This may be illustrated by those things which with man are called a full state when he is being... regenerated.
Then man's state is said to be full...

127 years = their fulness... Thus it is the fulness or end of what is holy of the Church... Their fulness, namely, that of the states and times of the Church, means their end... Its old age is called the fulness or end... So with the times and states of the day... When night comes, it is the fulness or end.
Its being said of the Lord, that He would come... in the fulness of times, or when there was fulness, signifies the same; for there was then no longer any good... or truth.
That a year and years = a full time of the Church. Illustrated.
In the midst of the years = in the fulness of time.
As a year is what is full of time... instead of a year they have an idea of what is full relatively to the states of the Church.
They are said to be two, to denote fulness.
What is full for initiation. Signified.
Ten, like a hundred, = a full state.
A state of departure appearing to them full. Signified.
Such a state was that which is meant by the fulness of times...
The earth... and its fulness = the Church and all things of the Church.
Thin is opposed to full; and that is called full in which there is use; or, what is the same, in which there is good.
That the medium had what is full of truth from good. Signified.
Three hundred = what is full.

His seed shall be the fulness of the nations () = that the truth of faith would reign... The fulness of the nations = abundance, thus that it would reign. Fulness, in the Word, = all; and where it does not = all, it = what is abundant; and it is predicated of both truth and good; for multitude is predicated of truth, and magnitude of good; thus fulness of both. Illustrated.
The earth and its fulness () = all, both truth and good, that is, of the Church.
Land () = the Church; and fulness, the good and truth therein. That both are signified is evident from the things which precede.
Seventy days = a full state.
That seventy = an entire period, thus a full state. Illustrated.
Hence it is said of Him that He would come in the fulness of time. AC 9228:3.
All the particulars here involve fulness.
Seven equally as seventy = a full state.
What is full of time in which he did not appear. Signified.
Three months = what is full of time, and what is full of state. Three = what is full, or an entire period from beginning to end.
Take to you the fulness of your fists () = power given so far as it could be received... So far as it could be received, is signified by fulness.
Thirty = a full state of remains; (for) by three is signified a full state.
What a full state is. Explained.
A homer... contained ten ephas, and therefore = what is full. Illustrated.
Ten acres = what is full, and also much.
Put therein the fulness of an omer of manna () = good therein as much as it contains.
In the third month = fulness of state.
What fulness of state is. Explained.
When a state comes to its end, it is then full, and is called fulness.
There is here meant the fulness of the prior state...
Corresponding penalty to the full. Signified.
It follows that (two and four) also = to the full; for that which is conjoined is full.

The number four = the restoration of interior good to the full. The reason why interior good is to be restored to the full, is that this good constitutes the spiritual life of man; and unless spiritual life is restored to the full, the exterior good which constitutes the exterior life cannot be restored.
He shall repay double = restoration to the full.
Seven years = a full state, thus to the full; and therefore to kindle a fire for seven years = to con sume to the full through cupidities.
Three years and six months = to the full.
1260 days, which make three years and six months, = to the full or up to the end.
A time, and times, and half a time... = to the full, or up to the end.
That seven = an entire period from beginning to end, thus what is full. Illustrated.
A full state of intelligence and wisdom from love and faith in the Lord. Signified.
Plenary destruction through the cupidities of the loves of self and of the world. Signified.
The plenary restoration of good and truth in the Church. Signified.
Sevenfold = to the full.
Seventy, also, = what is full. Also a week.

Three times in the year = a full state up to the end; for three = what is full from beginning to end... Here, therefore, plenary and complete deliverance... Thus plenary deliverance from damnation... Therefore man is then fully delivered. AC 9296. AC 9296:2.
The plenary implantation of truth in good... Signified.
The number of thy days I will fulfil = up to a full state.
To fulfil the number = to the full.
Up to a full state, means until the man is regenerated.
To desolate the earth and its fulness () = to destroy all things of the Church.
What is plenary as to information and influx. Signified.
Forty = what is plenary... Because four = what is full... In like manner ten. Illustrated.
Penalty to the full. Signified.
Two and a half = much and full. five = much and full... In like manner ten also a hundred.
What is full as to truth. Signified.
One and a half = what is full... because three has this signification. References.
What is full as to good and truth. Signified.
What is full as to scientifics from good. Signified.
Plenary conjunction in the ultimates of the spheres. Signified.
Fifty = what is full.
The plenary faculty of conjunction from good.
Fifty = what is plenary.
What is full of truth from good. Signified.
Thirty = what is full.
Twenty = what is full; thus in every way and altogether. (For) ten = what is full, and all.
Plenary support by means of truth. Signified.
Forty = what is plenary.

Two, and four = conjunction to the full... Therefore, also, what is full. And therefore in every way; for that which is fully is also in every way. By eight is signified what is full... also because a week = an entire period from beginning to end; and therefore by the eighth day is signified a full state. Illustrated.
What is full with good from the Lord. Signified.
A hundred = all, much, and full.
Goods and the derivative truths fully supporting. Signified.
Three = what is full. References.
By fulness () is signified all the truth and good which make the Church.
Five hundred = what is full. Explained. AC 10259.
The plenary closing up of the Internal. Signified.
Three thousand = what is plenary.
The Internal with them is plenarily closed up. That it is plenarily closed up...
They are mistaken who believe that Heaven is closed from fulness; when yet... a greater and greater fulness perfects it.
The degree of the affection and desire is as the measure, which is increased to the full. Signified.
That the Lord would come into the world in the fulness of times, which was when He was no longer Known by the Jews, and, from this, when nothing of the Church was left.
Therefore, when the Divine is in its ultimate degree, it is in its fulness.
That Divine truth in the sense of the letter... is in its fulness... General article.
The Lord never operates anything except in fulness, and the Word in the sense of the letter is in its fulness.
The Lord speaks with man only in what is full; and the Word in the sense of the letter is Divine truth in fulness.
The correspondence is plenary. DLW 413:end.
That the degrees of height are in their fulness... General article.
For they are in their effect; and every effect is the fulness of the causes.
The first arcanum is, that the Word in the sense of the letter is in its fulness...
The simpler and purer anything is, the more and the fuller it is.
a [end]. All reformation takes place in fulness, that is, in primes and in ultimates together.
Man is in full freedom to think and will, but not in full freedom to speak and act...
I have not found thy works full before God () = that the interiors of their worship are not conjoined with the Lord... They are called full before God when they are conjoined with the Lord.
Unless (truths from good) are in worship, the works are not full before God, but are empty... Hence what is full is predicated of the man in whom there are truths and goods.
Marriage is the fulness of man; for by it man becomes a full man.
The nuptials are an entrance to the plenary separation of the love of the sex from marriage love...
That after the nuptials, the marriage of the spirit becomes also of the body, and thus full. Explained.
One form, in which there is plenary unanimity and concord.
The time appointed for the New Church, when there is fulness and restoration.
Thus the universe as to essence and order is the fulness of God.
There is a plenary correspondence between Heaven and man.
In Christ dwells all the fulness of the Divinity bodily... From these things the Angels know that the Lord alone in the universal Spiritual Word is a full Man.
That an inmost and thus a plenary union took place.
All things are full of God, and everyone takes his own portion from that fulness.
They were full of confirmations for the plenary impotence of man in spiritual things.
Decision = the plenary consummation of both.
The fulness of time, in which the Lord came into the world, and in which He will come, is also consummation.

Seven = ... a full state... and as it = what is full, it also = all; because all make what is full; for fulness, relatively to those who make any society... are all; and therefore when magnitude is treated of in the Word, by seven is signified what is full...
Three, too, in the Word, = what is full, and all. References.

I have not found thy works full before God = that otherwise what is not Divine is in moral life... The things which are of moral life... are called full before God, when they are from a spiritual origin; and not full, when they are not from that origin... And therefore the works must be either full before God, or they are nothing at all before God.
Seven = all men and all things, and also what is full and the whole... for what is full and the whole is predicated of the magnitude of a thing, and all... of the multitude.
That this is the Divine truth which fills all things, is signified by, The fulness of the earth is His glory ().
Fulness = all things of (the Church). AE 304:28. Coro 34:2.
By the earth () is signified the Church as to good; and by its fulness are signified truths.
The floors are full of pure corn () = fulness thence.
Therefore man is born in plenary ignorance of all Knowledges of spiritual things.
Its fulness () = Knowledges in the external man.
Three is predicated of truths... and = fulness... and spiritual fulness is formed by truths.
The world () = Heaven and the Church as to good; and the fulness thereof = Heaven and the Church as to truth.
The land () = the Church; and the fulness thereof = the truths thereof from the Word.
Six weeks = ... also a plenary state; here, a plenary consummation of good and truth; that is, a plenary vastation of the Church.
By forty is signified either the plenary vastation of the Church, or a plenary state of temptation. Illustrated.
Full of days () = wisdom.
The plenary extinction of Divine truth and Divine good. Signified.
Three days and a half = what is plenary or full. Explained.
The city () = doctrine; and its fulness, the falsities of evil contained in it.
While it grows to the full. Signified.
1260 days = from beginning to end, and thus what is full... (For) three and a half, whether of years or days, = what is full.
These were the causes why the Christian Church... did not arrive at its fulness until after an age.
The earth () = the Church as to truth; and the fulness thereof = all truths in the complex.
As the Lord desires worship from goods and truths, it is said, The world is Mine and the fulness thereof (); fulness = goods and truths in their whole complex, as above.
That the Church called the New Jerusalem will stay among those who are in the doctrine of faith separated, while it grows to the full...
Full of the anger of God () = all the falsities of evil...
Full of names of blasphemy () = which are adulterated and falsified.
Full of abominations and uncleanness of whoredoms () = from profaned goods and truths.
By the fulness thereof () are signified all the goods and truths of the Church.
(Thus) Divine truth in the sense of the letter... is in its fulness. That is said to be full which contains in itself all the prior things even from the first... This fulness of the Word is like...
As Divine truth in its ultimate is in its fulness... therefore the Lord never operates except from primes through ultimates, consequently in fulness.
For man in the world is in his fulness.
God. 6. 8. As... the created universe is the fulness of uses in forms, it follows that the created universe is the fulness of God. CanonsNC 12. God. 8. 9.
That the fulness of time = consummation and desolation... The fulness (of natural times) is winter.
